name: The House
intro: Downstairs. The kettle is warm, which is strange, because you have not been up yet.
outro: The front door sticks the way it always has. You have never lived here.

nodes.label: The Kitchen
nodes.text: Everything is where you would have put it.

nodes.label: First, Water
nodes.text: You have not had any yet today. You never have.

nodes.label: Something Real
nodes.text: Not a plan, not a diet. One thing that grew, or one thing with protein in it.

nodes.label: One More Glass
nodes.text: Cheap, fast, and your head will thank you around eleven.

nodes.label: Make It Properly
nodes.text: Longer. Better. The kind of thing you tell people you do.

nodes.label: The Front Door
nodes.text: Outside, the street is doing its impression of an ordinary morning.
